description: Every way kvmd 4.206 refuses the GET /api/ws upgrade, recorded by hand with the websockets client (see README). The upgrade never happens: kvmd answers the GET with an ordinary HTTP response carrying its usual envelope, which is what websockets reports as InvalidStatus. Credentials are placeholders.

steps.name: bad_stream_value
steps.note: kvmd reads the flag with valid_bool, so anything outside its two lists is a validator failure rather than a stream index

result.error_msg: The argument 'abc' is not a valid bool (['1', 'true', 'yes'] or ['0', 'false', 'no'])

steps.name: unknown_user
steps.note: an unknown user is refused exactly like a wrong password: kvmd answers 403, not 401

steps.name: no_credentials
steps.note: empty X-KVMD-User: the auth chain finds no credential source at all, which is the only case that gives 401
